description_en: Modifies a whitelist rule for agentless sensitive file detection alerts
description_zh: 修改无代理检测敏感文件告警加白规则
kebab_example: aliyun sas update-malicious-file-whitelist-config --config-id 1 --event-name ALL --field fileMd5 --operator strEqual --field-value b2cf9747ee49d8d9b105cf16e078cc16 --target-type ALL --target-value ALL --source agentless --remark test --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateMaliciousFileWhitelistConfig

parameters.help_en: The rule ID. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, a whitelist rule is created
parameters.help_zh: 规则ID，选填，不传入则会新增加白规则
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en:
The alerting name. Valid values:
ALL: all Alarm Metric
parameters.help_zh:
告警名称：
ALL： 全部告警类型
parameters.name: event_name

parameters.help_en:
The operator used for rule matching. Valid values:
strEqual: string equals
parameters.help_zh:
规则判定操作符：
strEqual：字符串相等
parameters.name: operator

parameters.help_en: The value of the field to be whitelisted
parameters.name: field_value

parameters.help_en:
The type of the target scope. Valid values:
ALL: all assets
SELECTION_KEY: assets selected by using the asset selection component
parameters.help_zh:
生效目标类型：
ALL：全部资产
SELECTION_KEY：通过资产选择组件选中的资产
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
The target scope. Valid values:
ALL: all assets
Other values: the key of the asset scope selected by using the asset selection component
parameters.help_zh:
目标生效范围：
ALL：全部资产
其他：资产选择组件选中的资产范围Key
parameters.name: target_value

parameters.help_en:
The business source. Valid values:
agentless: agentless detection
parameters.help_zh:
业务来源：
agentless：无代理检测
parameters.name: source

Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因
